sources.entry: eLabFTW - Online lab notebook for research labs. Store experiments, use a database to find reagents or protocols, use trusted timestamping to legally timestamp an experiment, export as pdf or zip archive, share with collaborators…. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: eLabFTW is a self-hosted, browser-based electronic lab notebook for research teams, with an inventory database for reagents, cell lines and other objects.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes eLabFTW as an electronic lab notebook manager for research teams, accessed through a web browser. It lets users store and organize experiments and includes a database where objects such as antibodies, plasmids, cell lines and boxes can be recorded. Several research teams can share one installation, so it can be run at institute level. Listed features include trusted timestamping and blockchain timestamping, import and export in various formats, a calendar for booking equipment, a molecule editor, LaTeX support, a todolist, a public REST API, and an advanced permissions system. The README says it is available in 21 languages.
use_cases: electronic lab notebook for research labs
managing lab reagent and cell line inventory
booking lab equipment with a shared calendar
hosting lab records for a whole institute
how_to_run: Install Docker on a GNU/Linux server (Docker is required; PHP, webserver and MySQL come with the containers)
Follow the installation instructions in the eLabFTW documentation (linked from the README)
notable: Runs in Docker containers, so no separate PHP, webserver or MySQL setup is needed on the host
Supports multiple research teams on one installation
Trusted and blockchain timestamping of experiments
Public REST API (APIv2 client libraries exist in the related projects list)
Self-contained service that the README says does not send data to third parties
caveats: Requires at least 512 MB RAM (1 GB recommended) and 300 MB disk space
Installation requires Docker on the server; the README mentions GNU/Linux servers
Commercial PRO support and professional hosting are offered by Deltablot separately
keywords: store lab data on my own server
